title: Governors Awards Arrivals 2026: Florence Pugh, Zendaya, Timothée Chalamet and More Stars on the Carpet
summary: Glenn Close, Floyd Norman, Ridley Scott, Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler are being honored at the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences’ event, taking place Sunday night at the Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood.
tags: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
